cards.direction_or_boundary: Category medians span more than one unit for feature 7 and nearly one unit for feature 6.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Complete-category medians with disjoint observation halves, mean summaries, and an alternate response feature.
cards.object: All 1,430 observations in the largest anonymous condition-response panel.
cards.one_liner: One categorical condition axis partitions both anonymous response features into widely separated regimes in the largest landscape.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A held-out complete condition block supports the relationship if the feature-7 category span remains above 0.8; a span at or below 0.8 is failure.

cards.scope: Measured response-landscape structure only; anonymous features do not license a named chemical mechanism.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports structured selectivity variation across a large asymmetric-catalysis reaction space.
target_alignment.paper_location: High-throughput reaction-landscape Results and selected complete source-data panels.

cards.direction_or_boundary: Each selected within-panel mapping is strongly positive under raw, rank, half-panel, and endpoint-trimmed comparisons.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Panel-specific Pearson and Spearman mappings with contiguous halves and endpoint trimming.
cards.object: Complete selected feature pairs from observation sets 2, 3, and 4.
cards.one_liner: Three auxiliary panels each contain a strong low-dimensional numerical mapping, but the mapped feature pairs are panel-specific.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A new complete auxiliary panel supports recurrence only if a predeclared feature pair exceeds 0.70 correlation in both contiguous halves; failure in either half rejects transfer.

cards.scope: Cross-panel structural recurrence, not a claim that anonymous features share chemical identity.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source provides multiple complementary measurements for reaction-space transfer and validation.
target_alignment.paper_location: Supplementary cross-measurement panels associated with the reaction-space study.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
